Package com.hkust.marketplace.controllers.admin

Class AdminUserFormDialog

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.control.Dialog<User>
com.hkust.marketplace.controllers.admin.AdminUserFormDialog
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.event.EventTarget
final class AdminUserFormDialog extends javafx.scene.control.Dialog<User>
Task 3.3 – Add / edit user form.

Adding requires a unique username, a non-blank full name, a Buyer/Seller role and a password that satisfies the shared strength rule. Editing exposes the full name only; username and role are read-only and status is changed through the dedicated Deactivate / Reactivate actions.
